title: A converse to the discrete four-vertex theorem
summary: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the paper "A converse to the discrete four-vertex theorem", answering Tabachnikov's Problem 2. For every n >= 4, every cyclic sequence of positive numbers with two distinct plateau maxima and two distinct plateau minima is the sequence of circumradii of consecutive vertex triples of a simple, strictly convex, coherent polygon (circumcenters inside the vertex angles). Together with Dahlberg's discrete four-vertex theorem, also proved here, this characterizes the nonconstant radius sequences of such polygons. The realization can be chosen C^1 in the data near…

review.reason: Lean formalization of a converse to the discrete four-vertex theorem for convex polygons.
